title: Sotheby’s London Contemporary Art Sale Tallies $61.1 M., Led by a $12.9 M. De Kooning
summary: The house found homes for a healthy 28 out of the 34 lots on offer after three were withdrawn before the sale.

title: National Museum of Korea Director Scrutinized After Loaning Misattributed Work from His Private Collection to the Musuem
summary: Director You Hong-june faces scrutiny after loaning the institution a misattributed work from his private collection

title: Dino Bones Held in UK Museum for 100 Years Identified as New Species
summary: A researcher involved in the discovery described the long-overlooked fossil as a reminder of how much remains to be discovered in existing museum collections.

title: Minor Attractions, a New London Fair In a Hotel, Finds Space for Emerging Galleries and Artists
summary: The fourth edition of the fair runs until Saturday with 38 galleries from 15 countries placed in 16 bedrooms at the hotel.

title: A New Met Show Promises Rembrandt, as Never Seen Before
summary: “Rembrandt and the Ancients,” organized with the Louvre, will bring several of the artist’s works to the United States for the first time.

title: A Landmark Survey of Native Graphic Arts Defies Expectations
summary: The boundaries between craft, graphic arts, and sculpture collapse in “Designed to Be Red,” now on view at New York’s Poster House through next February.

title: Previously Unknown Canaletto Drawing Heads to Auction After Centuries in Private Hands
summary: A newly authenticated drawing by the Venetian master, depicting an imaginary architectural ruin, will go under the hammer in England on October 21.

title: Memorial Reflecting Pool Renovation Botched Beyond Previously Reported
summary: A report obtained by The Washington Post detailed problems and made no mention of vandalism.

title: French Collector François Pinault Plans Permanent Hang in Venice Museum
summary: The 90-year-old collector is planning a first permanent exhibition of 106 artworks by 54 artists at the Palazzo Grassi in Venice, opening in March 2027.

title: Tate Scoops Up Works by Michaela Yearwood-Dan, Luis Fernando Zapata at Frieze London
summary: Neither artist was previously represented in the museum network's collection.
